revision_history.reason: Replaced the inactive Gemma visual path with the predeclared Qwen3-VL fallback before restricted challenger inference.
Removed unsupported speech-by-vision cross-products and bound range families to the two actually executed instrument paths before restricted challenger inference.

amendment_reason: Bind complete range families to the two actually executed instrument paths rather than imply unexecuted ASR-by-VLM cross-products; no calibration aggregate or causal outcome was inspected.

evidence_reused.adversarial_boundary: The later confidence-sharpening lineage remains terminally stopped and is not reused.

primary_question: Across synthetic weak-alignment regimes provisionally bounded by multiple local instruments on one frozen ChildLens pilot, do synchronized training-only simulator-defined embodied cues improve simulator-oracle noun-object and verb-action grounding over matched absent, shuffled, time-shifted, and corrupted controls when side cues are absent at evaluation?
permitted_claim_template: Across synthetic weak-alignment regimes provisionally bounded by multiple local instruments on one ChildLens pilot, synchronized training-only embodied cues [improved/did not improve] simulator-oracle noun-object and verb-action grounding relative to matched controls.
forbidden_claims: ChildLens transcripts or referents are correct.
Local models substitute for German human annotation.
Model agreement is human reliability or ground truth.
The result generalizes to infants or BabyView.

ancestry.allowed_childlens_input: Only cell-suppressed, outward-rounded aggregate uncertainty ranges emitted by the frozen pseudo-calibration protocol.
ancestry.forbidden_childlens_input: Raw media, audio, frames, text, translations, item rows, timestamps, identifiers, exact small cells, pseudo-label payloads, model confidence, vocabulary, tokenizer, embeddings, weights, checkpoints, or effect sizes.
ancestry.learner_vocabulary: new opaque synthetic noun and verb symbols independent of ChildLens lexical content

naturalistic_calibration_layer.disagreement_policy: retain and widen ranges; never majority vote

synthetic_layer.base_generator: reuse the synthetic weak-alignment v1 event-bag and cross-situational mechanism interfaces after verifying zero empirical-value paths
synthetic_layer.required_extension: Add factorized opaque noun/object and verb/action meanings, a genuinely corrective event-selection update for both token kinds, and parameterized range input from the aggregate calibration receipt.
synthetic_layer.language: weakly delayed, nullable, ambiguous opaque noun and verb tokens with repeated cross-situational exposure
synthetic_layer.vision: synthetic object-form and action-dynamics observations with calibrated visibility and candidate multiplicity; no oracle IDs visible to the learner
synthetic_layer.side_cues: concept-agnostic simulator-defined event boundary, motion-change, and contact-change streams synchronized to latent events during training only
synthetic_layer.oracle: physically separate latent ledger used only for evaluation and a strong-alignment diagnostic ceiling

stress_construction.within_family_sampling: For every corpus seed, use the same fixed seven-point maximin Latin-hypercube draw over that family's outward-rounded joint bounds; reuse the draws across all five arms.
stress_construction.fallback_if_a_dimension_is_suppressed: Use the full prespecified simulator domain for that dimension and label the family conservative-unbounded; do not impute a point value.

heldout: object-action compositions with both atoms exposed elsewhere
concepts_and_splits.zero_exposure_panel: chance-only leakage falsifier, not an acquisition endpoint

seed_plan.paired_bundle: all seven range families, all five arms, and all three model seeds for one corpus seed

inference.contrast: synchronized minus each of absent, shuffled, time-shifted, and corrupted within each corpus and range family
inference.method: one-sided 95% Student-t lower confidence bound over 40 corpus effects with exact sign test as corroboration
inference.intersection_union: both endpoints and all four comparators must pass separately within every required range family

pre_outcome: side-only concept probes are at most chance plus 0.02
all weak controls have learnable headroom and are non-saturated
shuffled, shifted, and corrupted bundles preserve their declared nuisance marginals
event-selection disconnection removes the synchronized fixture advantage
no side, oracle, concept, target, or empirical field reaches evaluation
falsification_and_gates.go: Every range family, including the conservative envelope, passes both co-primary endpoints against every comparator and every falsification passes.
falsification_and_gates.revise: A technical, privacy, model-path, calibration-envelope, strong-ceiling, or construction gate fails before scientific endpoints are opened; permit one bounded engineering correction without changing ranges or thresholds.
falsification_and_gates.stop: The valid one-shot outcome fails either co-primary endpoint in any required range family, confidence changes occur without corrected wrong/tied mappings, corrupted/disrupted cues match synchronized, or empirical/privacy leakage is detected.

calibration_disposition.required_next_action: A separately frozen user-chosen calibration remedy or an explicitly empirical-free protocol must supersede this blocked launch state.

execution.implementation_task: Add only the aggregate-range binding and dual noun/verb corrective update to a small nonempirical extension of weak-alignment v1, with synthetic fixtures and fail-closed ancestry/evaluation tests; do not build a new infrastructure lineage.
execution.multi_gpu: one complete bundle per identical GPU; never split arms or range families across device types within a bundle
execution.single_m5: serialize the one MPS-heavy trainer and use two to four CPU workers for generation/scoring
execution.next_task: Do not launch. Obtain the user's substantive choice between a separately frozen replacement-instrument calibration revision and an explicitly empirical-free sensitivity protocol.
